introHtml: Full color decoration on pedometers allows you to reproduce logos, gradients, or detailed artwork with photographic clarity. Whether you are outfitting a corporate wellness challenge or distributing step counters at a health fair, full color imprinting ensures your brand stands out on devices like the Widescreen Walker or Tap 'n' Read Fitness Tracker. This decoration method works best for designs that require more than one or two colors, giving you maximum visual impact on a small canvas.
